text:
maya: Quick heads up — integration suite on main is red after today's lockfile merge (merged PR #4321). Failing test: tests/integration/test_tls.py::test_expired_cert — looks like a TLS root/cert change. Anyone else seeing this?

ci-bot: CircleCI job build/integ: https://circleci.example/gh/redwood/infra/5678

ci-bot: Failure excerpt:
```
E       ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: certificate has expired (_ssl.c:XXXX)
...
>       assert verify_certificate_chain(chain, truststore)
E       AssertionError: Chain validated unexpectedly
```

devon: Reproduced locally on ubuntu-latest docker image. Quick repro:
```
docker run -it --rm ubuntu:22.04 bash
apt update && apt install -y python3 python3-pip
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
pytest tests/integration/test_tls.py::test_expired_cert -q
```

samir: My guess is a transitive bump in certifi or urllib3 from the lock regen. Can someone bisect the lockfile changes? If not, I can run a quick bisect in ~30m.

zara: I looked at the lock diff — certifi was updated to 2024.11.1. That change updates the root bundle; our test intentionally validates an expired intermediate and relied on older bundle behavior. Two short options: 1) pin certifi back in constraints for short-term rollback, or 2) make the test not depend on system truststore (use a local test CA). Rolling back lockfile bump would get CI green fastest.

devon: I can open a revert PR to pin certifi==2024.10.3 in constraints.txt and update the lock. Command I'll run:
```
sed -i 's/certifi==2024.11.1/certifi==2024.10.3/' constraints.txt
poetry lock --no-update
```
I'll post the PR shortly: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4334

maya: For medium-term we should update the integration to control truststore. But agree revert for now so product teams aren't blocked. @samir please bisect so we have a precise causal commit.

samir: On it. Running bisect now, will paste results.

zara: Thanks all — tagging @eng-oncall in case this hits prod-facing infra. :thumbsup:
